newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed in active trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed in Tuesday's active trade, with Croatia Banka coming into the spotlight as the biggest gainer.
* Of 16 active issues seven rose, five fell and four were flat.
* Volume rose to 20,299 from 9,249 units and turnover doubled to 7.6 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer was Croatia Banka which added 30 kuna (or 20 percent) to 180 kuna, on volume of 2,770 shares.
* Biggest decliner was hotelier Istraturist losing nine kuna (or 4.7 percent) to 181 kuna with 2.682 shares sold.
* Most active issue was fully-listed drugs company Pliva which fell 14 kuna to 493 kuna, selling 4,052 shares.
